    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Migrate to the Google GenAI SDK<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p>
</p>



<p>Starting with the Gemini 2.0 release in late 2024, we introduced a new set of
libraries called the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/libraries">Google GenAI SDK</a>. It offers
an improved developer experience through
an <a href="/gemini-api/docs/migrate#client">updated client architecture</a>, and
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/migrate-to-cloud">simplifies the transition</a> between developer
and enterprise workflows.</p>

<p>The Google GenAI SDK is now in <a href="/gemini-api/docs/libraries#new-libraries">General Availability (GA)</a> across all supported
platforms. If you&#39;re using one of our <a href="/gemini-api/docs/libraries#previous-sdks">legacy libraries</a>, we strongly recommend you to
migrate.</p>

<p>This guide provides before-and-after examples of migrated code to help you get
started.</p>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> The Go examples omit imports and other boilerplate code to improve
readability.</span></aside>
<h2 id="install-sdk" data-text="Installation" tabindex="-1">Installation</h2>

<p><strong>Before</strong></p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pip<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-U<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-q<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"google-generativeai"</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">npm<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>@google/generative-ai
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="go" data-text="Go" tabindex="-1">Go</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">go<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>get<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>github.com/google/generative-ai-go
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="java" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="XML"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">&lt;dependency&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;groupId&gt;com.google.ai.client.generativeai&lt;/groupId&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;artifactId&gt;generativeai&lt;/artifactId&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;version&gt;0.9.0&lt;/version&gt;
&lt;/dependency&gt;
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p><strong>After</strong></p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_1" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pip<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-U<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-q<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"google-genai"</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_1" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">npm<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>install<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>@google/genai
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="go_1" data-text="Go" tabindex="-1">Go</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">go<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>get<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>google.golang.org/genai
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="java_1" data-text="Java" tabindex="-1">Java</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="XML"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">&lt;dependency&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;groupId&gt;com.google.genai&lt;/groupId&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;artifactId&gt;google-genai&lt;/artifactId&gt;
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>&lt;version&gt;1.67.0&lt;/version&gt;
&lt;/dependency&gt;
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<h2 id="client" data-text="API access" tabindex="-1">API access</h2>

<p>The old SDK implicitly handled the API client behind the scenes using a variety
of ad hoc methods. This made it hard to manage the client and credentials.
Now, you interact through a central <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Client</code> object. This <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Client</code> object acts
as a single entry point for various API services (e.g., <code translate="no" dir="ltr">models</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">chats</code>,
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">files</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">tunings</code>), promoting consistency and simplifying credential and
configuration management across different API calls.</p>

<p><strong>Before (Less Centralized API Access)</strong></p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_2" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><p>The old SDK didn&#39;t explicitly use a top-level client object for most API
calls. You would directly instantiate and interact with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">GenerativeModel</code>
objects.</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google.generativeai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Directly create and use model objects</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">GenerativeModel</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'gemini-3.7-flash'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">generate_content</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">...</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">chat</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">start_chat</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">...</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_2" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><p>While <code translate="no" dir="ltr">GoogleGenerativeAI</code> was a central point for models and chat, other
functionalities like file and cache management often required importing and
instantiating entirely separate client classes.</p>

<section><h3 id="python_5" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><p>With Google GenAI SDK, you create an API client first, which is used to call

variables, if you don&#39;t pass one to the client.</p>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Set the API key using the GEMINI_API_KEY env var.</span>

<h2 id="context-caching" data-text="Context caching" tabindex="-1">Context caching</h2>

<p>Context caching allows the user to pass the content to the model once, cache the
input tokens, and then refer to the cached tokens in subsequent calls to lower
the cost.</p>

<p><strong>Before</strong></p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google.generativeai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">caching</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Download file</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">requests</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/data/a11.txt'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">pathlib</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Path</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'a11.txt'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">write_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
